messages:
Jordan (Finance): Hey team — booking question. My corpcard was charged at checkout but the card provider flagged the transaction because the merchant code shows as "Travel Agency" instead of "Lodging". Charge is $412.34 to "EXPEDIA PARTNER SOLUTIONS". Receipt only has a subtotal and total, no itemized folio. I need to submit this expense for reimbursement/GL coding. Any advice?
Sam (People Ops): Do you have manager approval for the stay? Was this booked via our travel portal or personally?
Jordan (Finance): Booked through Expedia (not the travel portal). Marta pre-approved the trip in Slack thread last week. Manager note: "Approved for client onsite — Marta". Card used: company corpcard (ends 3241).
Priya (Finance): If the MCC is 4722/Travel Agency vs 7011/Lodging that can block card-policy rules. Can you paste the card transaction metadata (merchant name + MCC) from the bank statement?
Jordan (Finance): Sure — copy from banking UI: 
```
2026-03-21 19:12 UTC | EXPEDIA PARTNER SOLUTIONS | $412.34 | MCC 4722
```
Priya (Finance): OK. Two things: 1) For this one-off, we can allow it if you attach the manager approval and the hotel folio showing room nights. 2) For recurring vendor issues we need finance to open a case with the card provider to request MCC recategorization.
ExpenseBot: :warning: Automated alert — Transaction flagged: foreign-mcc mismatch (policy=lodging_only). Follow-up required before auto-reconciliation. Reference: TICKET-EXP-7891
Marta (EM): Confirmed — I approved the trip in #eng last Thursday. Jordan, please attach the manager approval screenshot and the booking confirmation/email when you file. I'm fine signing off for lodging.
Jordan (Finance): Uploads booking_confirmation.pdf and manager_approval.png (links) — also attaching the emailed folio I got (only shows total). Link: https://files.redwood/expedia/folio_412.pdf
Priya (Finance): Submitted guidance: 1) Submit expense in Expensify under Lodging > Travel: Lodging. 2) In the notes field include: "Manager pre-approval (Marta), vendor charged under Expedia (MCC 4722), attached folio and booking confirmation. Finance ticket TICKET-EXP-7891." 3) If the vendor doesn’t provide an itemized folio, include a short memo explaining charges breakdown (room nights x rate + taxes). We’ll code to GL 6100-Travel-Lodging.
Sam (People Ops): Quick FYI — for future hotel stays please use the company travel portal to avoid MCC mismatches where possible. If booking off-portal, cc people-ops@redwood so we can pre-authorize the merchant.
Priya (Finance): I'll open a vendor ticket with the card provider for Expedia Partner Solutions to see if MCC can be adjusted for future charges. Jordan — once you file the expense mark it as "pending finance review" and paste the Expensify link here.
Jordan (Finance): Will do. Filing now and will paste link. Thanks all :thumbsup: 
Jordan (Finance): Expense submitted: https://expensify.com/receipt/RE-239482 — status pending review.
Priya (Finance): Got it. Marking this as approved pending final folio verification. If card provider updates MCC we’ll update the merchant whitelist.
Marta (EM): Thanks. No further action from my side.
ExpenseBot: :white_check_mark: TICKET-EXP-7891 updated: finance assigned (Priya), status = investigating.
notes: Include manager approval screenshot + folio link per Priya's instructions
